انأطرا (form VII)
# اِنْأَطَرَا (inʔaṭarā) /in.ʔa.tˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# اِنْأَطِرَا (inʔaṭirā) /in.ʔa.tˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
